method: AST-extracted named pure predicate only; no full evaluator invocation, actor evaluation, repair or rescore
control: Append Every retry uses the same request ID to an in-memory copy; captured bytes remain unchanged
independent_review: Manual bounded review confirms stable ID, same-renewal retry reuse, deduplication, retention, timeout uncertainty/reporting, privacy and input ownership. Review is not owner acceptance.
interpretation: Concrete lexical false negative; task did not require every/each/all phrase adjacency
limits: One ended capture; not arbitrary natural-language equivalence
No claim that all other predicate cases are correct
No hidden feedback to scored actors
